title: IndiGo's 20,000 Free Ticket Giveaway: How to Enter Before the Window Closes
excerpt: The airline's 20th anniversary 'IndiGoFree' campaign offers fare refunds up to ₹10,000 per booking, with the booking window ending August 6.
body:
• IndiGo is giving away 20,000 free domestic tickets as fare refunds of up to ₹10,000 per PNR through its 'IndiGoFree' campaign.
  • The booking window runs August 4-6, 2026, exclusively through IndiGo's website, mobile app, and Skai AI assistant.
  • Winners are selected randomly from eligible bookings and must correctly answer one IndiGo-related question to claim their refund.
  • The offer covers Economy and IndiGoStretch bookings on domestic one-way, round-trip, connecting, and multi-city flights.

IndiGo's 20th anniversary celebration has moved from milestone nostalgia to a concrete giveaway: 20,000 free domestic flight tickets, distributed as fare refunds of up to ₹10,000 per booking. The 'IndiGoFree' campaign, which opened on August 4, closes at the end of August 6.

The offer represents one of the largest promotional giveaways in Indian aviation history, though the fine print reveals it is a lottery rather than a guaranteed discount.

How It Works

Eligible passengers must book domestic flights through IndiGo's direct channels — the official website (goindigo.in), the IndiGo mobile app, or Skai, the airline's AI-powered virtual assistant. Bookings made through third-party platforms like MakeMyTrip or Cleartrip do not qualify.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=6gR46RVbdK8

Every qualifying booking enters a random, system-generated selection process. Those selected receive an IndiGo-related trivia question via email and WhatsApp. Participants get three attempts to answer correctly. A right answer triggers a full fare refund of up to ₹10,000 for that PNR.

The campaign covers both Economy Class and IndiGoStretch cabin bookings, including one-way, round-trip, connecting, and multi-city domestic itineraries. International bookings and codeshare flights are excluded.

What's New Since the Anniversary Launch

IndiGo marked its 20th birthday on August 4 with celebrations across its network. The airline, which began with a single aircraft in 2006, now operates a fleet of over 420 planes and carries roughly 63% of India's domestic passengers.

The free ticket campaign adds a consumer-facing incentive to the anniversary, building on the airline's history of using birthday sales to drive bookings during traditionally slower travel periods. Last year's 19th anniversary sale offered fares starting at ₹1,219 — a standard discount rather than a giveaway.

"20 Years. 20,000 Free Tickets. One Epic Celebration."

— IndiGo anniversary campaign tagline

The Fine Print

Several conditions apply. Bookings made outside the August 4-6 window are ineligible. Fare Hold bookings must be completed within the sale period to qualify. The refund amount cannot exceed ₹10,000 per PNR — meaning passengers on more expensive routes would receive a partial reimbursement rather than a fully free ticket.

The trivia question mechanism also means that winning the lottery alone is not sufficient. A participant who fails all three answer attempts forfeits the refund.

How Diaspora Travelers Can Benefit

While the offer covers only domestic legs, Indian Americans planning trips home can pair an international booking with a separate domestic IndiGo booking through direct channels to enter the giveaway. Connecting flights within India for family visits, pilgrimage travel, or regional tourism during a trip home could qualify.

With the booking window closing at the end of August 6, travelers who have been considering domestic flights have a narrow window to try their luck.
